items.title: Meta Muse exposes users' personal and business secrets when they share conversations

items.lede: Meta says it paused a Muse feature that lets you share conversations with the AI assistant after researchers found the URLs publicly available on the web, as reported by Ars Technica. In a report published this week, researchers at the security firm Claroc say they found more than 6,800 Muse links through public DNS records. […]
items.title: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web

items.lede: Researchers accessed 6,800 shared conversations with the AI agent, including internal company documents.
items.title: Meta suspends Muse chats sharing feature after it left private details exposed

items.lede: The company is suspending the feature after security researchers discovered how easy it was to access sensitive information shared with the AI assistant.
items.title: A Design Flaw in Share Links Exposes Users’ Personal Conversations With Meta’s Muse
